subject.title: feat(sessions): add local timezone prefix to archive filenames

question: Should OpenClaw accept Option B, a local-date prefix plus canonical UTC suffix, as the persisted reset/deleted session archive filename contract?
rationale: This changes a user-visible persisted filename shape for session archives, so maintainer intent is needed for the compatibility contract even if the implementation is repaired.

options.title: Accept Option B after coverage
options.body: Require QMD archive-hit support, old/new archive reader tests, real configured reset/delete proof, and a refreshed branch before merge.

options.title: Choose another filename policy
options.body: Keep the linked feature request open and ask for a narrower design if maintainers prefer metadata/search display over changing archive basenames.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause this PR if changing persisted archive filenames is not worth the compatibility and session-history risk right now.

recommendation.title: Accept Option B after coverage
recommendation.body: Require QMD archive-hit support, old/new archive reader tests, real configured reset/delete proof, and a refreshed branch before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent source-seam refactor history makes this the strongest available owner signal for the persisted filename boundary and upgrade policy choice.
